verify.publicIntro: Verify any Saudi tax invoice QR code without signing in. Everything runs locally in your browser — the invoice is never sent to an external service.

verdictHint.green: The QR structure matches the e-invoicing specification and no conflict was found with the invoice data.
verdictHint.yellow: The QR is readable but there are notes or missing parts that need a human review.

reason.vatOverTotal: VAT amount is greater than the total
reason.mismatch_vatNumber: VAT number in the QR differs from the invoice
reason.mismatch_total: Total in the QR differs from the invoice
reason.minor_sellerName: Seller name differs from the printed one
reason.minor_timestamp: Date differs from the printed one
reason.minor_vatTotal: VAT amount differs from the printed one
